keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «최초의 올림픽은 고대 그리스에서 제우스를 위한 축제로 열렸다(주제)» 와 «근대 올림픽이 이 오래된 전통을 이어 가고 있다(결론)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the topic (the first Olympic Games were a festival for Zeus in ancient Greece) and the conclusion (the modern Olympics follow this old tradition). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.qen: When and where were they held?
How is it connected to today?
boxes.a: The modern Olympics follow this tradition

sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

words: ancient
고대의
The first Olympic Games were held in ancient Greece almost 3,000 years ago
from a very long time ago
event
종목, 경기
At first, there was only one event, a short running race.
one race or game in a sports competition
compete
경쟁하다, 참가하다
Only free Greek men and boys could compete in the games.
to take part and try to win
crown
관
they got a crown made of olive leaves.
a round thing worn on the head as an honor
agreement
협정, 약속
a special peace agreement allowed athletes and visitors to travel safely.
a promise that two or more groups make
tradition
전통
The modern Olympics, which started in 1896, follow this old tradition.
something people have done for a long time

qs.q: Why could athletes and visitors travel safely during the games?
qs.qko: 경기 기간에 선수와 방문객은 왜 안전하게 여행할 수 있었나요?
opts: Because of a special peace agreement
Because the games were held in Rome
Because every winner got a gold medal
evs: During the games, a special peace agreement allowed athletes and visitors to travel safely.
The games took place every four years in a place called Olympia.
Winners did not receive gold medals; instead, they got a crown made of olive leaves.
Only free Greek men and boys could compete in the games.
why: 경기 기간에는 특별한 평화 협정 덕분에 안전하게 여행할 수 있었다고 했어요.
The text says a special peace agreement allowed athletes and visitors to travel safely.

qs.q: In "Only free Greek men and boys could compete in the games," what does "compete" mean?
qs.qko: «Only free Greek men and boys could compete in the games» 에서 «compete» 는 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: To take part in a contest and try to win
To sell food to the visitors
evs: Only free Greek men and boys could compete in the games.
Married women were not even allowed to watch.
The ancient games ended more than 1,500 years ago.
The games took place every four years in a place called Olympia.
why: 자유민인 그리스 남자와 소년만 «경기에(in the games)» 할 수 있었던 일이니, compete 는 직접 경기에 나가 이기려고 겨룬다는 뜻이에요.
The sentence tells who could do this «in the games», so «compete» means to take part and try to win.

qs.q: Which clues show that the ancient games were different from today’s Olympics?
qs.qko: 고대 올림픽이 오늘날 올림픽과 달랐다는 단서는 무엇인가요?
opts: Winners got olive crowns, not gold medals, and married women could not even watch
Winners got gold medals, and everyone could watch
Only women could compete in the games
evs: Winners did not receive gold medals; instead, they got a crown made of olive leaves.
The games took place every four years in a place called Olympia.
Married women were not even allowed to watch.
The modern Olympics, which started in 1896, follow this old tradition.
why: 우승자가 금메달 대신 올리브 잎 관을 받았고, 결혼한 여성은 구경조차 할 수 없었다고 했어요. 두 문장을 함께 봐야 해요.
Winners got a crown of olive leaves instead of gold medals, and married women were not even allowed to watch. You need both sentences.

ends: What happened at the first modern Olympics in 1896?
1896년 첫 근대 올림픽에서는 무슨 일이 있었을까요?
When did women start to compete in the Olympics?

write.src: “It is important to <u>play fair in sports</u> because <u>everyone wants a safe and fun game</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «중요한 일 + 그것이 중요한 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write an important thing to do and why it is important.

chips.b: our muscles need to get ready
chips.label: warm up

write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because everyone can be safe)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because everyone can be safe)
